### ST-092

**Versioned machine-readable output contracts**

*As a **CI maintainer**, I want **stable JSON schemas for `scan`, `impact`, `run` and `explain`**, so that **scripts don't break between minor versions**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 2 | S10 | P09 | [ST-085](REP-reporting-and-coverage-scope.md#st-085) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Schemas published in the package and docs
- [x] Breaking schema changes require a major version (checked by a schema-diff test)
- [x] All `--json` outputs validate against their schema in tests

---

### ST-093

**GitHub Actions template**

*As a **CI maintainer**, I want **a documented workflow for affected tests on PRs**, so that **adoption in CI takes minutes**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 3 | S10 | P01, P07 | [ST-063](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-063), [ST-091](REP-reporting-and-coverage-scope.md#st-091) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Template fetches enough history for merge-base, runs `run --affected --mode balanced` on PRs and `--all` on main
- [x] Uses least-privilege permissions and is safe for fork PRs (no secrets required)
- [x] Uploads HTML/JSON/JUnit artifacts and writes the job summary

### ST-094

**Basic CI quality gates**

*As a **tech lead**, I want **CI to fail on policy findings (missing required categories, forbidden fallbacks)**, so that **policies are enforced, not just reported**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟦 Could | 3 | STRETCH | P03, §16.4 | [ST-068](RUL-rules-engine.md#st-068) |

**Status:** ⬜ todo — Stretch story.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] `run --fail-on policy` exits 5 on policy findings
- [ ] Gates are configurable per rule
- [ ] Gate results appear in all report formats
